description: This file defines functions to add command-line arguments for platform configuration, logging, and launching in a build system, and includes helper functions to create parameter objects from argument parsers.

methods.name: AddLoggingArguments
methods.description: Adds a command-line argument for setting the logging level with choices like 'info', 'debug', etc.

methods.name: AddPlatformConfigArguments
methods.description: Adds command-line arguments related to platform configuration, including platform, config, loader platform, and loader config.

methods.name: AddLauncherArguments
methods.description: Adds command-line arguments required for launchers, including device ID, target parameters, and output directories.

methods.name: CreatePlatformConfigParams
methods.description: Creates and initializes a PlatformConfigParams object from command-line arguments.

methods.name: CreateLauncherParams
methods.description: Creates and initializes a LauncherParams object from command-line arguments, parsing target parameters into a list.
